source_role: REFERENCE - the public-domain airport gazetteer used to turn a latitude/longitude in an ADS-B trace into a named field. CC0, no auth, no rate limit.

note: Nearest-airport resolution is GEOMETRY, not a landing record. A trace point 1.2 km from a runway threshold is strong; one 14 km away names the nearest field and nothing more. Every resolved airport on this site carries its distance for that reason.
